hooks.description: Run the full test suite and a syntax check whenever a JS file under js/ or tests/ is saved.
hooks.name: test-on-save

commands: sh -c "grep -q '^\.kiro' .gitignore && echo 'BLOCKED: .gitignore excludes .kiro — remove that line' && exit 1 || echo '.gitignore OK — .kiro stays committed'"
hooks.description: Remind the agent that .kiro/ must stay committed and never be gitignored.
hooks.name: spec-guard
